narrative.overview: Quetzalcoatl supplies the underlying shape, type and physical-control language. The user explicitly superseded the initial light/dark composition: every page surface now stays dark, Workshop Orange and Amber form the primary accent pair, and project cards carry more purposeful decoration. The site prioritizes works, preserves all README-driven data, and uses the existing sunlit personal photograph. Source reference: `Quetzalcoatl design system/readme.md`, tokens, component specifications and showcase. Shipping tokens are copied under `site/design-system/quetzalcoatl/` so builds do not depend on an untracked reference folder.
